steps.label: 3. Test each Function
steps.sub: a real HTTP request, before any script touches it

code:
Function: getCustomerByEmail
  HTTP Method: GET
  Endpoint: /customers?email=${email}

Function: createCustomer
  HTTP Method: POST
  Endpoint: /customers
  HTTP Header: Content-Type = application/json
  Content: {"email":"${email}","name":"${name}"}
caption: A GET needs a query placeholder; a POST needs a header and a body template.

eyebrow: A real test run returns a real response
caption: Not a simulation — a genuine outbound call to the real external system.
